headline: Centre finishes unbeaten while Trinity (Texas) sets the pace
dek: Trinity (Texas) has piled up seventeen wins against just three losses and one draw across all matches, pairing 53 goals with a defense that has allowed only ten. Centre still tops the conference table without a conference loss, clear of Sewanee and Trinity (Texas).

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring drops sharply down the table: Trinity (Texas) has 53 goals across all matches, more than Oglethorpe, Southwestern (Texas), and Millsaps combined.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
